description: This file defines the LeaveBalanceModel class within a human resource management system. The class models leave balance information such as entitled leave, used leave, scheduled leave, pending leave, taken leave, and balance, along with relevant dates. It implements serialization behavior for API responses and interacts with LeaveBalance entity objects.

classes.name: LeaveBalanceModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing leave balance information in API responses, implementing normalization and converting internal LeaveBalance entities into a structured API format.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the LeaveBalanceModel with a LeaveBalance entity, setting filters and attribute names for serialization.
